prompt: how to add new user to citrix my account
response: Adding a new user to Citrix My Account involves navigating to the user management section within the Citrix portal. Click on 'Users' and then 'Add User.' Enter the necessary details such as username, email, and any additional information required by your organization's policy. Make sure to assign the appropriate roles and permissions to the new user. Once you've completed these steps, the new user will be added to your Citrix My Account.
